title: Naturally Crunchy Syrian Beef Stock Kebabs
description: A winey, crunchy, nostalgic Syrian dish featuring beef stock, grill, and vegan-friendly options, this recipe is perfect for those looking for a flavorful and textured meal. The combination of beef stock and crunchy elements creates a unique taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, making sure it reaches a safe internal temperature of 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together beef stock, red wine, olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes, making sure it reaches a safe internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the marinated tofu onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until they are golden brown and crispy on the outside.
While the kebabs are grilling, heat the crunchy chickpeas in a pan over medium heat for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Once the kebabs are done, brush them with the remaining marinade and top with crunchy chickpeas and chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
To ensure food safety, always cook the tofu to an internal temperature of 165 degrees Fahrenheit and refrigerate any leftovers promptly.
